newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesia palm olein stable in late trade.
newsitem.headline: Indonesia palm olein stable in late trade.

text.p: Indonesian palm olein prices were generally stable in late trading on Wednesday after early gains as buying interest waned, traders said.
They said olein was quoted at 1,445-50 rupiah/kg in Jakarta, but offers were also heard at 1,435-40 rupiah.
The traders said a 10,500-tonne crude palm oil tender in the North Sumatran city of Medan on Thursday was expected to give some price direction.
One trader said a plantation house was tendering parcels of 500 tonnes each for January, February and March delivery and 3,000 tonnes each for April, May and June delivery.
"The seller is tendering such a big volume because he wants to take advantage of the good prices in Europe," the trader said. "Tight freight is keeping prices in Europe high."
Traders said they expect local olein prices to edge higher because of the relatively high crude palm oil price, but added that the ceiling would appear at 1,500 rupiah.
The state logistics agency BULOG has said olein prices should not exceed 1,500 rupiah/kg ahead of the Moslem Ramadan fasting month in January.
